related.title: Istio：HTTP條件在TCP DENY規則中的缺屬性效應
related.titleEn: Istio: missing HTTP attributes in TCP DENY policies
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：50%與58.333%可重算，permit不能覆蓋有效forbid，錯誤不被誤稱為引擎自動Deny。 交付cedar-parc.json、雙層決策表與缺屬性負例；提供政策ID與修訂以便重作。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 50 and approximately 58.333 percent, ensure permit cannot override valid forbid, and accurately report skip-on-error rather than inventing engine-wide deny-on-error semantics. Deliver cedar-parc.json, the two-layer decision table and missing-attribute counterexamples, including policy identifiers and revisions sufficient for reproduction.
related.difference: 建立HTTP與TCP連線描述，記錄目的埠、method是否存在及政策selector；使用缺值而非空字串表示TCP沒有HTTP方法。
related.differenceEn: Build HTTP and TCP connection descriptors with destination port, method presence and policy selector. Represent an unavailable HTTP method as absent, not as an empty string that accidentally changes the policy matching semantics.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 引擎略過錯誤政策不代表應用必須忽略錯誤；本課外層准入要求Allow且errors為空，將引擎語意與產品選定規則分開測試。 12筆中引擎有8筆Allow，其中2筆伴隨錯誤診斷；其他4筆Deny，固定母體並保留各政策ID。 外層准入率(8−2)/12×100=50%；修復其中一筆錯誤且引擎仍Allow後為(8−1)/12×100≈58.333%。
本課依文件檢查DENY的缺屬性效應，將方法限制明確限於HTTP目的埠；計算原本誤受影響的TCP集合大小，不把ALLOW規則缺值語意混用。 20筆連線中8筆為TCP且目的埠非8080；未限埠的HTTP DENY在模型中影響這8筆，其他12筆另依HTTP條件判定。 非預期影響率8/20×100=40%；加上8080埠範圍後該8筆中誤受影響數為0，比例0%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Skipping an erroneous policy inside the engine does not require the application to ignore diagnostics. The local wrapper admits only Allow with an empty error list, testing engine semantics separately from the product decision layered above them. Of 12 requests the engine allows eight, including two with error diagnostics. Four are denied. Keep the population and policy IDs fixed so that wrapper withholding cannot be mistaken for a change in Cedar engine behavior. Wrapper admission is (8−2)/12×100=50 percent. Repairing one error while retaining its engine Allow gives (8−1)/12×100, approximately 58.333 percent; the other error still withholds the operation.

Follow documented DENY behavior for missing attributes and scope the method restriction to its intended HTTP port. Count the unintentionally affected TCP set without importing different missing-value assumptions from an ALLOW policy. Of 20 connections, eight are TCP on ports other than 8080. The unscoped HTTP-based DENY affects those eight in the model, while twelve HTTP rows are evaluated against their own method conditions. Unintended impact is 8/20×100=40 percent. Adding the intended 8080 scope leaves zero of those eight TCP rows unintentionally affected, or zero percent of the fixed population.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Fulcio：憑證SAN與OIDC發行者的雙重身分綁定
related.titleEn: Fulcio: binding certificate SAN to OIDC issuer identity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：50%與58.333%可重算，permit不能覆蓋有效forbid，錯誤不被誤稱為引擎自動Deny。 交付cedar-parc.json、雙層決策表與缺屬性負例；提供政策ID與修訂以便重作。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 50 and approximately 58.333 percent, ensure permit cannot override valid forbid, and accurately report skip-on-error rather than inventing engine-wide deny-on-error semantics. Deliver cedar-parc.json, the two-layer decision table and missing-attribute counterexamples, including policy identifiers and revisions sufficient for reproduction.
related.difference: 建立14份公開憑證描述，保留SAN、OIDC issuer擴充、EKU與簽章時間；另列CA發行者名稱，明確區別X.509 issuer與OIDC issuer。
related.differenceEn: Build 14 public certificate descriptors with SAN, OIDC issuer extension, EKU and signing time. Record the CA issuer name separately, explicitly distinguishing an X.509 issuer from the identity-provider issuer used by the signer policy.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 引擎略過錯誤政策不代表應用必須忽略錯誤；本課外層准入要求Allow且errors為空，將引擎語意與產品選定規則分開測試。 12筆中引擎有8筆Allow，其中2筆伴隨錯誤診斷；其他4筆Deny，固定母體並保留各政策ID。 外層准入率(8−2)/12×100=50%；修復其中一筆錯誤且引擎仍Allow後為(8−1)/12×100≈58.333%。
本地政策要求SAN與OIDC發行者精確匹配，且先通過鏈與用途檢查；不能把issuer的字串部分比對或顯示名稱當作穩定身分。 14份中10份SAN符合，其中8份也符合OIDC issuer；另外4份SAN不同，皆不納入雙重匹配集合。 雙重匹配率8/14×100≈57.143%；修復一份測試描述的issuer關聯後為9/14×100≈64.286%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Skipping an erroneous policy inside the engine does not require the application to ignore diagnostics. The local wrapper admits only Allow with an empty error list, testing engine semantics separately from the product decision layered above them. Of 12 requests the engine allows eight, including two with error diagnostics. Four are denied. Keep the population and policy IDs fixed so that wrapper withholding cannot be mistaken for a change in Cedar engine behavior. Wrapper admission is (8−2)/12×100=50 percent. Repairing one error while retaining its engine Allow gives (8−1)/12×100, approximately 58.333 percent; the other error still withholds the operation.

The local policy requires exact SAN and OIDC issuer matches after chain and usage checks. Substring issuer matching and display-name comparison are not stable identity contracts and must not substitute for the selected typed certificate fields. Ten of 14 descriptors match SAN, and eight of those also match OIDC issuer. Four have a different SAN and remain outside the joint set even if they share an otherwise trusted CA or identity provider. Joint matching is 8/14×100, approximately 57.143 percent. Correcting one fixture issuer association gives 9/14×100, approximately 64.286 percent, without adding another trusted identity provider.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
